In \ref{fig:LCS}, the dataset is generated through the following steps:
1. Split the document into sentences.
2. Enumerate all unused sentence pairs in the document and generate their normalized copies.
3. Calculate the Longest Common Subsequence (LCS) from the normalized copies using SuffixAutomaton \url{https://github.com/laohur/SuffixAutomaton}, and a pair with a sufficiently long LCS is considered similar.
4. Sample similar pairs into the dataset.
5. A sentence whose length exceeds the maximum length will be randomly cropped in the dataloader \cite{izacard2022unsupervised}.
